prerequisites: Authentic controller product/workstation assignment and owned lease via approved registry workflow
Independent current-source approval, enforced protection and exact-source/result CI
Explicit approval of reconciled policy and publisher/service ownership
Exact reviewed artifact SHA plus no-effect staging and backup/rollback verification
excluded: Security, credential, protection or network changes
rollback: Before approved installation, preserve the existing three files and their metadata. Quiesce the approved publisher service; replace and restore the checker/publisher as one compatible set. Restore the complete prior set if validation fails; never restart an incompatible mixture.
limitations: No deployment command is supplied before assignment and approval.
Remote status deduplication does not coordinate independent publishers on different hosts.
Already exhausted SHA/context histories cannot be repaired by appending more statuses.
